more_info.overview: Bentonite is a natural clay consisting principally of hydrated aluminium silicate, with variable quantities of other mineral components. Its very fine particles provide a large surface area that can adsorb other substances. FDA describes direct-food use as a processing aid, with no significant residue expected when good manufacturing practice is followed. The mineral composition and colour can vary between deposits.
